limitations: One run per compression level while the root Rust workspace build and self-model child were active; not isolated CPU or disk measurements.
Local reads may use the operating-system cache; these numbers do not measure cold repository open or cold semantic restoration.
Memory covers only the bounded benchmark process, not the existing service's large JSON serialization/deserialization allocations.
This compresses the legacy JSON envelope with a zlib wrapper, not the planned v2 ZIP metadata-plus-raw-frontier representation; actual v2 size, encode/decode time and memory remain unmeasured.
The repository fixture may gain R2 later. Reproduction pins the immutable R1 cache digest; database inventory can then differ.

decision.storage: Retain transactional SQLite blobs: only 309992 bytes of this measured database lie outside blob payloads; separate CAS files do not address the dominant cache encoding cost.
decision.codec_direction: Introduce a versioned service cache using ZIP deflate level 1 with separate metadata JSON and raw kernel-frontier entries; retain the legacy v1 decoder and source fallback.
decision.correctness: Compression changes a discardable cache representation only; source/publication/context/closure authentication remains required.
decision.acceptance: Measure the actual v2 implementation before reporting its product-level performance.

reproduction.original_execution: Two inline PowerShell here-strings piped to python -; no standalone script file existed during the recorded measurement.
reproduction.note: Equivalent reusable read-only benchmark added afterward. The exact R1 cache digest is fixed; later repository inventory may include R2. The script has not rerun compression, so its existence does not create another measurement.
